role: style reference only; independent complete clouds, not image crops

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production-ready reusable 2D cloud sprite for a side-scrolling pixel-art train wallpaper. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for its clouds and palette, not an edit target and not to be cropped. Paint a completely new complete cloud with all its silhouette present, including the bottom that would normally be obscured by mountains. Truly TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no sky or scene or checkerboard rendered into it. Style: flat hand-painted anime pixel art; irregular nested cut-paper-like paint regions, scalloped stepped contours with large, medium, and very fine cloud lobes. Warm soft-white outer sunlit crests on upper-left, pale blue interior shapes, layered azure-blue inner shadow masses. No 3D spherical shading, no smooth airbrushing, no blurry volumetric cotton balls, no thick black outlines. Match the reference's restrained flat color blocks and dense organic contour detail. Palette hints: whites #FBFBF8 and #F7F4EC, pale blues #DCE DF8 (pale icy blue), #C6E6FC, middle #B6DDFC and #A3D4FD, deeper #91CBFC and #7EBFED. Keep 10% truly transparent padding on ALL sides. No elements touching the frame, no straight crop edges, no rectangular image patch, no ground, mountains, train, vegetation, sun rays, contrails, text or labels. Lighting consistently from upper left. Sharp confident edges, crisp detailed flat color islands at roughly 2-4 pixels, large connected areas of blue with broken white rims. This is a single isolated reusable game art asset, not a poster.
Subject: one large asymmetrical cumulus cloud cluster, landscape 3:2 canvas. Taller rising turret left of center, a lower secondary rounded shoulder on the right, broad scalloped gently flattened but fully rounded closed lower silhouette. Keep everything contained and disconnected from frame. The whole cloud occupies about 78% of canvas width, 75% height.
